# `browser-tab bookmark`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab bookmark [FLAGS] <action>`
- **Aliases**: `bm`

Read or edit bookmarks (search|list|create|update|remove) — needs daemon + extension

## Arguments

### `<action>`

search | list | create | update | remove

## Flags

### `--browser <name>`

Which browser (required when >1 extension is connected)

### `--query <text>`

search: substring over title and URL

### `--folder <id>`

list: folder to read (omit for the root)

### `--recursive`

list: flatten the whole subtree

### `--id <id>`

update/remove: node to act on

### `--parent <id>`

create: destination folder

### `--title <title>`

create/update: title (create with no --url makes a folder)

### `--url <url>`

create/update: target URL

### `--limit <n>`

Max rows
